statement: Let eta(G) be the minimum order of a finite Abelian group Gamma for which G has an induced embedding into a simple undirected Cayley graph Cay(Gamma,S), with S=-S and 0 not in S, as frozen in source.md and interpreted in problem.md. Then eta(K_{1,1,5})=15. The lower bound covers every finite Abelian group of order below 15: Theorem 6 of the cited primary source excludes orders below 10, and exact exhaustive enumeration excludes Z10, Z11, Z12, Z2 x Z6, Z13, and Z14. The upper bound is the explicit verified Z15 certificate in evidence/order15-witness.json.
contribution: This resolves the single frozen complete-multipartite value. The copied primary source gives only the bracket 10 <= eta(K_{1,1,5}) <= 15 and says the unbalanced complete-multipartite problem is open; the submitted exact search closes every intervening Abelian group type and separately verifies the order-15 witness. No broader classification or priority claim is asserted.
